title: Verify Cline provider/model fix and agent-bootstrap regression before resuming ERP-074
description: Control-plane verification of the automated executor bootstrap after four consecutive Cline exit code 1 quarantines (ERP-074..077). Confirm the provider/model pinning fix (AI_CLINE_PROVIDER=deepseek, AI_CLINE_MODEL=deepseek-v4-pro, --provider deepseek) actually removes the Cline Credits default, confirm the trimmed scripts/agent-bootstrap.ps1 no longer contains PowerShell parser errors and does not regress safe fast-forward/repair behavior, and perform a bounded dry-run invocation of ERP-074 to capture cline_exit_code and finish_reason. Do not implement ERP business logic, do not modify start_agent.bat provider semantics beyond verification, do not touch production database/OSS, do not deploy or release.
acceptance_criteria: The task records the exact provider invocation used by the automation (AI_CLINE_PROVIDER, AI_CLINE_MODEL, --provider) and demonstrates that it no longer defaults to Cline Credits.

PowerShell parses scripts/agent-bootstrap.ps1 successfully (no unclosed string / parser error) and the script still performs or explicitly documents the removal of the fast-forward merge, path-conflict check and Repair-DeferredBrowserFailedHead behavior.
A bounded dry-run start of ERP-074 is executed and its cline_exit_code and normalized finish_reason are written to .ai/results/ERP-078.json without silently quarantining the task.

If the dry-run still fails, a bounded root-cause statement (command, stderr excerpt, suspected cause) is written to .ai/audit.jsonl and the task is marked failed with required next action, instead of another silent quarantine loop.
No business logic, no source under src/ERP.*, no production database, no production OSS, no deployment or release is changed by this task.
The task result clearly states whether ERP-074 may be safely resumed by the rolling queue.

human_gate.reason: Automation control-layer verification only. No business logic, production database, production OSS, deployment or release action is authorized.
